summary: Proposal Phase 1 — Task 5a (MIGRATION half only; the CreateQuoteDialog VAT UI is a separate later task). Adds the canonical pure calculator public.generate_vat_periods(p_frequency text, p_stagger integer, p_from date, p_to date) RETURNS TABLE(period_start date, period_end date, period_label text). It turns a company's VAT profile (companies.vat_frequency + companies.vat_stagger_group) into the exact set of UK VAT return periods over a window, so acceptance can materialize one job per period. Reads NO tables and writes NO rows (never touches public.vat_periods) — STABLE, SET search_path TO 'public'.

problem.context: Proposal Phase 1 needs per-period VAT lines/jobs. The UK VAT stagger arithmetic must live in one authoritative DB function rather than being re-derived per caller. This receipt covers the generator function ONLY; wiring it into the VAT proposal UI and creating vat_return lines is Task 5's UI half (later).
problem.uk_vat_rules: quarterly stagger 1 → ends Mar/Jun/Sep/Dec; stagger 2 → Apr/Jul/Oct/Jan; stagger 3 → May/Aug/Nov/Feb (a quarter ending month M starts on the 1st of month M-2). monthly → 12 calendar-month periods/yr. annual/annual_accounting → one period per year ending at the chosen annual period-end MONTH passed in p_stagger (1..12); period runs the 12 months up to and including that month-end.

expected_objects.object: function public.generate_vat_periods(text, integer, date, date) exists as a STABLE pure calculator returning TABLE(period_start date, period_end date, period_label text)
expected_objects.verify_via: catalog_functions: public.generate_vat_periods is present, provolatile='s' (STABLE), search_path='public', and its body contains NO 'INSERT INTO' / no write to vat_periods.

expected_objects.object: quarterly stagger 1 over a full calendar year yields 4 periods ending Mar/Jun/Sep/Dec
expected_objects.verify_via: Behavioural: db_rpc generate_vat_periods('quarterly', 1, '2025-01-01', '2025-12-31') returns exactly 4 rows with period_end 2025-03-31, 2025-06-30, 2025-09-30, 2025-12-31 and labels 'VAT Q/E 31 Mar 2025' … 'VAT Q/E 31 Dec 2025'. period_start of the first row = 2025-01-01.

expected_objects.object: monthly over a full calendar year yields 12 periods
expected_objects.verify_via: Behavioural: db_rpc generate_vat_periods('monthly', 1, '2025-01-01', '2025-12-31') returns exactly 12 rows, period_end = last day of each month Jan..Dec 2025, labels 'VAT M/E DD Mon 2025'.

expected_objects.object: annual over a full calendar year yields exactly 1 period ending at the p_stagger month-end
expected_objects.verify_via: Behavioural: db_rpc generate_vat_periods('annual', 3, '2025-01-01', '2025-12-31') returns exactly 1 row with period_end 2025-03-31, period_start 2024-04-01, label 'VAT Y/E 31 Mar 2025'. Also confirm the alias: generate_vat_periods('annual_accounting', 3, '2025-01-01', '2025-12-31') === the same 1 row.
